name: Wietzendorf (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Wietzendorf (crossed black rakes on white above a green base).
history: Municipal flag of Wietzendorf; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Wietzendorf arms — crossed rakes on white
